declared_failure_behavior.value: Reject non-audit responses, fence drift, head-fence inequality, stale revisions, malformed payloads, malformed members, scope/fence drift, and presence drift explicitly. Bridge outage surfaces as BridgeUnavailable with no hold claimed; per-record retention resolves through the owner resolver with caller-carried holds only, and withheld members carry gap postures. Malformed bridge bytes fail closed as integrity errors, never as partial projections.
